name: GlassAuroraDisplay

tests.note: templated smoke/axe/reduced-motion boilerplate (105 lines, same template as Nebula/Biome/Weather); no behavior assertions

material_impl: Outer shell and control bar use OptimizedGlass (L834, L714) but then stack redundant utility classes 'glass-backdrop-blur border border-border/20' on top. Actual content is a Canvas2D drawing with ~40 hard-coded RGB literals (aurora presets L159-190, sky gradient L460-465, info box rgba(15,23,42,.72) L616). Canvas font is set to 'var(--typography-body-size) sans-serif' (L620) which is invalid in Canvas2D and silently falls back to 10px sans-serif. No tokens reach the canvas.
motion: Custom rAF loop that calls setState (setAnimationTime, setAuroraLayers, setSolarWindParticles, setStarField) every frame (L672-681) -> full React re-render at 60fps, and the effect depends on render/update callbacks that change every frame, so the rAF loop is torn down and re-created each frame. Reduced motion is wired via useMotionPreferenceContext (L667) but then calls render() once before layers exist. Plays a 'success' sound on random shooting stars (L403) and 'error' on simulated storms (L438).
a11y: Canvas has no role/aria-label/fallback text; all data (intensity, latitude, etc.) is painted into pixels so it is invisible to AT. Controls have labels but hard-coded ids ('aurora-intensity', L724) -> duplicate ids with multiple instances. 5 of 6 controls are dead: onChange={(e) => {}} on color select (L753), activity select (L772), time slider (L794), and three checkboxes (L805, L814, L823) -- they render as interactive but cannot change.
api: forwardRef + className passthrough. 20+ props; colorPreset/activityLevel/observationTime/showStars are props but UI pretends they are user-editable. realTimeMode is random simulation (L413-445). latitude only printed as text. Not controlled/uncontrolled-consistent.
ssr: 'use client'. No module-scope window access. Canvas fixed at style={{width, height}} = 800x500px (L860) -> overflows on mobile; no DPR scaling (blurry on retina).
fake_complexity: High. 'solar wind', 'geomagnetic activity', 'real-time data mode' are Math.random simulations; activityLevel only printed; latitude unused for physics; 'Visibility: Good/Poor' derived from hour only.
justification: A demo toy, not a design-system component: a canvas science-fair simulation with dead controls, invalid canvas fonts, per-frame React re-renders, fixed 800px width, and a certification capture that is essentially a near-black rectangle (canvas region max channel saturation 25/255, i.e. no visible aurora bands) with a debug info box. Aurora as a brand surface already exists in AuroraPro and marketing/AuroraBackground; this one adds nothing a premium system should ship.
evidence: src/components/atmospheric/GlassAuroraDisplay.tsx:860 style={{ width, height }} fixed px canvas
reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-atmospheric-glassauroradisplay/desktop.png pixel analysis: dark canvas, max saturation 25 in canvas region

name: GlassBiomeSimulator
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell, but controls bypass it with bespoke inline styles: controlSurface gradient/border/boxShadow literals (L1123-1129), toggle track/thumb literals (L1144-1148), control panel background rgba(248,250,252,.52) (L1162), canvas wrapper shadow (L1281) and an injected <style> block with slider thumb/track rgba literals (L1267-1274). Canvas uses hex/rgb biome palettes (L197-276). strokeStyle='var(--glass-bg-hover)' (L826) and fillStyle 'var(--glass-white)' (L903) are invalid canvas colors.
motion: rAF loop with per-frame setState (setAnimationTime, setParticles) (L1086-1093) -> 60fps React re-render; effect re-subscribes whenever render callback identity changes (every frame since animationTime is a dep). Reduced motion wired via context (L1081). Toggle thumb uses CSS 'left' transition (layout property).
a11y: Best of the atmospheric set: real working controls, role='switch' + aria-checked toggles (L1131-1152), focus-visible outline injected (L1273), labelled selects. But Toggle component is declared inside renderControls (L1131) so it remounts every render (60fps) -> focus can be lost mid-interaction. Hard-coded ids 'biome-select' etc. collide across instances. Canvas has no text alternative.
api: forwardRef, className. Takes biome as initial value only (useState(biome) L184) -- props changes ignored (uncontrolled-only despite onBiomeChange). ambientSoundLevel, seasonalTransitions, wildlifeActivity props accepted but unused. Season select changes nothing visually.
ssr: 'use client'; canvas responsive (width:100%, aspectRatio) L1287 but no DPR scaling.
fake_complexity: High: 'simulator' draws primitive ellipses/triangles; 'season', 'wildlife', 'ambient sound' are cosmetic or no-ops; desert config references 'cactus' element type that is never drawn.
justification: A 1.3k-line canvas toy that someone has partly restyled (neutral palettes, nice switch controls) but which remains a simulation demo with dead props, per-frame React re-render, invalid canvas colors and bespoke inline material that bypasses the glass primitives. It has no place in a component library's public surface; if a demo is desired it belongs in the docs site, not the npm package. The control styling (switch, range thumb) is the only salvageable part and should be implemented once in the real Switch/Slider components.

name: GlassNebulaClouds
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell with inline overrides rgba(255,255,255,.24) background/border (L813-817) and select/range accentColor '#526071' literals (L829-875). Canvas: every color is passed through neutralizeColor() (L162-171) which converts it to grayscale silver -- a 'nebula' with emission-line palettes that renders grey. Info box fillStyle 'var(--glass-text-secondary-dark)' (L720) is invalid for canvas, so the box inherits the previous fillStyle.
motion: rAF + per-frame setState; updateNebulaLayers depends on animationTime (L443) so the callback, render and the rAF effect are re-created every frame. Background stars are regenerated with Math.random() inside render (L541-549) -> 100 stars teleport every frame (strobing noise). setInterval mutates other state and fires callbacks/sound inside a setState updater (L477-502), a React anti-pattern (double-invoked in StrictMode).
a11y: role='region' + aria-label on shell (L964-965). All 8 controls dead: onChange={(e)=>{}} (L826, 854, 872, 893, 905, 916, 927, 938). Hard-coded ids. Label typo '{(temperature/1000).toFixed(1)}K K' (L878).
api: forwardRef, className; data-testid passed twice (L963 and spread). Props-only for every visual param but UI pretends otherwise.
ssr: 'use client'; fixed px canvas style={{width,height}} 800x600 (L980) -> overflows mobile; no DPR.
fake_complexity: High: 'stellar evolution', 'ionization', 'magnetic field', 'spectral class' are random numbers; then everything is desaturated to grey, nullifying the physics-y colour model.
justification: Worst-in-shard: entirely non-functional controls, per-frame random star strobing, re-created rAF loop each frame, invalid canvas colors, fixed pixel size, and a palette deliberately neutralised to grey so it no longer even reads as a nebula (certification screenshot average saturation 2.4/255). Nothing here is reusable design-system material.
evidence: src/components/atmospheric/GlassNebulaClouds.tsx:443 animationTime dependency re-creates loop per frame

name: GlassWeatherGlass
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell/controls; canvas uses rgba weather palettes (L164-200), accentColor 'rgb(72 78 88)' literals. 'rainbow' is drawn in four greys (#ffffff..#c3c8d0, L560) -- a grey rainbow. Canvas info box uses roundRect without feature guard (L700).
motion: Best loop in the set: callbacks held in refs so rAF isn't torn down (L733-772), DPR-scaled canvas (L806-809). Still setAnimationTime every frame (L756) -> 60fps React re-render, and generateParticles builds intensity*100 particles per frame only to slice them (L474-481). Reduced motion wired.
a11y: role='region' + aria-label. Weather select / intensity / temp controls work; 'Auto Update' and 'Responsive' checkboxes are dead (L909, L920). Hard-coded ids. Canvas data not exposed.
api: forwardRef, className. weather prop is initial-only (useState L147). autoUpdate prop works but its checkbox doesn't. Day/night effect (L265-283) and weatherResponsive effect (L233-262) both write backgroundGradient and fight.
ssr: 'use client'; window.devicePixelRatio read in effect only (OK). Responsive canvas (L962-967).
fake_complexity: Medium-high: 'auto weather updates' are Math.random; no real weather data/input; pressure/visibility are display-only.
justification: Technically the least-broken atmospheric canvas (refs, DPR, responsive), but it is still a demo simulation with dead toggles, wasteful per-frame allocation and grey 'rainbows'; the screenshot is almost uniformly pale grey (mean luminance 243, saturation 0.6). Four sibling canvas simulations share copy-pasted particle code; none belong in the package. If weather-reactive ambience is wanted, it should be a token-driven background preset, not a 1k-line canvas.

name: AtmosphericBackground
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root (L142) + CSS module layers (AtmosphericBackground.module.css). Default gradient is four near-white rgba stops (L19-24) and baseColor rgba(226,232,240,.72) -> visually a flat pale wash. blur/blurAmount props are accepted but blurStyle is an empty object with leftover '// Use createGlassStyle() instead' comments (L136-139) -- the blur feature is unimplemented.
motion: CSS keyframe animation via module classes with --atmosphere-gradient-duration; reduced motion respected through both hook and context (L54-60). Interactive mode sets React state on every window mousemove (L73-83) -> re-render per mouse event.
a11y: role='img' + generated aria-label when decorative (L154-158) is reasonable; but tabIndex=0 when interactive (L160) makes a background focusable with no keyboard behaviour.
api: forwardRef with manual ref merge, className/style passthrough, intent/elevation/tier cast 'as any' (L144-146). Uses '@/lib/utils' cn while siblings use utilsComprehensive cn.
ssr: 'use client'; window access guarded inside effect.
fake_complexity: Low-medium: 'atmospheric effects' amounts to a gradient + a cloud overlay class; blur is a no-op.
justification: Small and SSR-safe, but it is one of at least four overlapping 'ambient gradient background' components, has an unimplemented blur prop, and its default output is a near-invisible pale wash (screenshot mean luminance 243, saturation 2.0). A premium system needs exactly one backdrop/ambient-light component with token-driven presets that are tuned to make glass read; fold this into that.

name: DynamicAtmosphere (GlassDynamicAtmosphere)
material_impl: Plain div + CSS module; uses createGlassStyle() when blur (L285-288) and a canonical blur ladder 16-48px with saturate/brightness/contrast chain (L291-311) -- the most token-aligned material code in this shard, though the ladder is a hand-written ternary chain. applyAlpha() returns color unchanged for rgb/hsl/var inputs (L33-36), so 'intensity' has no effect on the default var() colors except via opacity. Default primaryColor 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' vs others plain var() -- inconsistent token format.
motion: CSS animations driven by --atmosphere-animation-duration; deterministic seeded particle layout (L243-259, SSR-stable). Mouse/scroll modes setState per event (L445, L474). 'audio' and 'time' interaction modes are declared in the type (L51) but not implemented.
a11y: Decorative: effect layer aria-hidden, container pointer-events none. Container itself has no aria-hidden though it is purely decorative.
api: forwardRef, className/style; exported under two names (DynamicAtmosphere, GlassDynamicAtmosphere) and root exports only 'DynamicAtmosphere' (src/index.ts:487) while displayName is 'GlassDynamicAtmosphere'. intent/elevation/tier declared but never used. particleElement prop declared, unused. Sets CSS vars imperatively in useEffect (L206-230) -> first paint has no background (flash).
ssr: 'use client'; window guarded; seeded particles avoid hydration mismatch. Imperative style set means SSR HTML lacks the gradient.
fake_complexity: Low-medium: 'audio' interaction mode is a lie (no-op).
target: single <GlassBackdrop preset=...> (this file is the best base)
justification: The most reasonable of the background family: SSR-stable seeded particles, CSS-driven animation, canonical blur ladder via createGlassStyle. It should become the base of one consolidated backdrop component, after removing unimplemented modes (audio/time), unused props (intent/elevation/tier/particleElement), moving the gradient computation into render (no first-paint flash), and fixing applyAlpha so intensity works on token colors (color-mix for all inputs).

name: ParticleBackground
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root + CSS module layers; canvas with hard-coded navy gradient rgba(7,12,28)/(20,28,52) (L36-39) and baseColor linear-gradient literal (L52-53). getColorValues regex parser hard-codes white for any var()/color-mix input with comment 'In a real implementation, you'd parse the CSS variable at runtime' (L125-133). Note: story/screenshot reads pale (mean luminance 239), contradicting dark defaults.
motion: rAF canvas loop; O(n^2) connection test per frame (L204-224). Canvas effect depends on mousePosition (L281) so every mousemove tears down and restarts the rAF loop and re-adds the resize listener. Particles mutated in place inside state. Reduced motion stops rAF after one frame (L262). No DPR scaling.
a11y: role='img' with aria-label on a container that also renders children (L350, L370) -- role=img makes children presentational, hiding real content from AT. tabIndex=0 when interactive (default true) (L352) -> a focusable background with no keyboard behaviour.
api: forwardRef; duplicate aliases count/size/speed/color vs particleCount/particleSize/particleSpeed/particleColor (L56-66, L100-106). blur via CSS var. intent/elevation/tier 'as any'.
ssr: 'use client'; particles generated client-side only (good); window used in effects only.
fake_complexity: Low: it is what it says (connected particle field), but the 'CSS variable color' support is fake.
target: single particle effect (one of GlassParticles / GlassParticleField / ParticleBackground) or the GlassBackdrop preset
justification: Generic 2015-era 'particles.js' connected-dots effect -- the opposite of the premium Liquid Glass bar -- with an rAF loop restarted on every mouse move, fake CSS-variable color parsing, role=img hiding children, and a focusable decorative background. At least four particle components exist; keep at most one, rebuilt with stable loop, DPR, token colors and aria-hidden decoration.

name: EnhancedGlassButton
material_impl: Does NOT use OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial; plain <button> with utility classes 'glass-foundation-complete glass-surface-primary ...' (L239-251), so its material differs from GlassButton. Size classes glass-h-xs/glass-px-xs etc. (L219-223) are a separate sizing scale from GlassButton's h-6/h-8/h-10.
motion: Wraps in GlassPhysicsEngine by default (physics.enabled true, L148) plus optional Morphing/3D/Organic/Spatial engines; each wrapper changes the element tree, so toggling features remounts the button. Reduced-motion hook read (L139) but never used.
a11y: Native button preserved; physics wrapper given tabIndex -1 (L382). No loading/disabled semantics beyond native. Ref forwarded only via useEffect on [ref] (L469-475) -> ref is stale/null when wrapper remounts the button.
api: forwardRef (broken as above). Variant set (primary/secondary/destructive/ghost/outline) differs from GlassButton's 13 variants. enhancedFeatures object prop defeats memoization (features memo depends on object identity). userId default 'default-user'. Preset components PhysicsGlassButton/ImmersiveGlassButton/VRGlassButton/SmartAdaptiveButton/UltraEnhancedButton are React.FC without forwardRef and are not root-exported.
ssr: 'use client'; statically imports ~3.6k lines of engines (GlassPhysicsEngine 569, Glass3DEngine 642, SpatialComputingEngine 765, OrganicAnimationEngine 860, GlassMorphingEngine 827) plus framer-motion and emotional-intelligence/AI-personalization utils regardless of which features are enabled. window.location read in click handler only.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'Biometric tracking' feeds clickPressure: Math.random()*0.5+0.5 and dwellTime: Date.now()%5000 explicitly marked '// Simulated' (L294-295); behaviour analysis uses Math.random interactionFrequency/decisionTime/errorRate (L305-307). 'Emotional intelligence' and 'AI personalization' therefore classify random noise. Header comment promises AR/VR, physics, AI (L3-13).
justification: Marketing-driven fake complexity: 'biometric' and 'emotional' adaptation derived from Math.random, a default physics wrapper, broken ref forwarding, and a 3.6k-line static dependency graph for a button. It forks the material and sizing scales from GlassButton, undermining consistency. Delete it (and its five preset wrappers); any genuinely useful press/ripple physics should be a small opt-in prop on GlassButton.
evidence: src/components/button/EnhancedGlassButton.tsx:27-41 static imports of 5 engines + AI utils

name: GlassButton
material_impl: Shared primitives: OptimizedGlass (L950) by default, LiquidGlassMaterial when material='liquid' (L885), Slot for asChild. Variant table maps 13 variants to OptimizedGlass knobs (L637-754). But the component-level defaults glassVariant='frosted', intensity='medium', tint='neutral', border='subtle' (L234-239) are always truthy, so `glassVariant || variantConfig.glassVariant` (L758), `intensity || variantConfig.intensity` (L954), `tint || variantConfig.tint` (L956), `border || variantConfig.border` (L957) ALWAYS take the defaults -> destructive/success/warning/gradient tints, intensities and borders never apply; all variants render the same neutral frosted glass. Hard-coded liquid tint {255,255,255,.1/.06} (L894-896). Classes like 'glass-gradient-primary glass-gradient-primary glass-via-secondary-opacity-20 glass-gradient-primary' (L935, L1008) are duplicated/nonsensical.
motion: Optional Motion preset wrapper; OptimizedGlass liftOnHover/press/magnet always on. Dynamic Tailwind class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.normal}ms]` (L606) cannot be generated by JIT. useReducedMotion called (L279) but prefersReducedMotion is never used -- 'scale-105', 'animate-pulse', liftOnHover, magnet are not gated.
a11y: Native button, glass-focus ring, createButtonA11y ids/aria, loading announced via live region (L585-589), aria-disabled on loading. iconOnly label validation effect is an empty no-op (L560-564). Icon-only xs = 24px and sm = 32px targets (L595-596) below 44px. Contrast: screenshot shows a near-invisible button on white (button region max saturation 26, faint outline).
api: forwardRef via useImperativeHandle; asChild Slot; className passthrough; but the root rendered element is a wrapper <div class='glass-inline-glass-block'> (display:inline-block, L826, glass.css:3182) so fullWidth's w-full on the button is constrained by an inline-block parent -> fullWidth is broken, and layout classes (flex-1, grid placement) passed via className land on the inner button not the wrapper. Rules-of-hooks violation: conditional hook calls `predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null` etc. (L287-300) crash/mismatch when those props toggle at runtime. Variant names overlap with intent/tint/glassVariant -> four overlapping colour axes. File also exports IconButton, ButtonGroup, ToggleButton (name clashes with root-exported toggle-button/ToggleButton), FloatingActionButton, Conscious/Gaze/Predictive/AccessibleButton presets -- none root-exported (src/index.ts:265-266 only GlassButton/Button).
ssr: 'use client'. Statically imports GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking (webgazer loader), GlassSpatialAudio for every button even when unused (L25-31) -> heavy bundle for the most-used component.
fake_complexity: High in the 'consciousness' layer: biometric adaptation hard-codes `deviceCapabilities = { isMobile: false, isDesktop: true }` ('For now, assume desktop', L360-361) and shrinks the button to 'sm' when 'stress' is low; AccessibleButton preset is 'accessibility-focused' by making buttons smaller and adding sound. Core button is real.
justification: The library's most important primitive and the right flagship slot, but today it is a 1.4k-line grab-bag: variants silently collapse to identical neutral glass because defaulted props shadow the variant table, fullWidth is broken by an inline-block wrapper div, reduced motion is read but ignored, conditional hooks violate the Rules of Hooks, and five 'consciousness' engines are bundled into every button. Redesign as a lean (~250 line) button: render the button itself as root (no wrapper), one colour axis (variant/intent), 3-4 sizes with >=44px touch targets, motion gated by reduced motion, and move consciousness features out entirely.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-button-glassbutton/desktop.png: tiny low-contrast button on white, max saturation 26

name: GlassFab
material_impl: OptimizedGlass for variant='glass' (L644) but class stack also adds 'bg-white/10 glass-backdrop-blur border border-white/20' (L235) on top of the primitive -> double material. Non-glass variants use raw Tailwind 'bg-primary-500 hover:bg-primary-600' etc. (L240-252) -- solid fills not glass and not part of the glass token set; ring colours 'ring-blue-400/40 shadow-blue-400/20' hard-coded (L623).
motion: Motion preset scaleIn wrapper; isVisible enter/exit via opacity/scale classes + timeout; inline transition string overrides class transitions (L630). 'animate-pulse-ring' pulse. prefersReducedMotion read (L358) but unused.
a11y: 'outline-none' in base classes (L598) with no replacement focus ring on the standard variant -> no visible keyboard focus. Tooltip is a visual-only span shown on mouse hover (L742-746), not exposed via aria-describedby and not shown on focus. createButtonA11y used. Default size 'medium' = 56px good.
api: forwardRef (Fab) -- GlassFab casts ref (L772). Size names 'small/medium/large' differ from GlassButton 'xs..xl'; colour via 'color' prop vs GlassButton 'variant' vs 'intent' -- three naming schemes. Conditional hooks (L410-422) same Rules-of-Hooks violation as GlassButton. fabRef assignment guarded by `fabRef.current !== undefined` (always true, meaningless). Default export is Fab, root export only GlassFab (src/index.ts:475).
ssr: 'use client'; same static import of five advanced engines (L20-27).
target: GlassButton (shape='fab' / a thin GlassFab wrapper over the redesigned button)
justification: Two FABs exist (this and GlassButton's FloatingActionButton); this one has its own size vocabulary, solid non-glass fills, double material, removed focus outline and a hover-only tooltip. Rebuild as a ~60 line positioning/shape wrapper over the redesigned GlassButton and the library Tooltip.
evidence: src/components/button/GlassFab.tsx:235 bespoke bg-white/10 backdrop-blur on top of OptimizedGlass
src/components/button/GlassFab.tsx:742-746 hover-only tooltip not linked via aria

name: MagneticButton (GlassMagneticButton)
material_impl: Delegates to GlassButton (inherits its variant-collapse bug). No own material.
motion: Window-level pointermove listener per instance (L224) gated by isHovered, so the 'magnetic radius' (default 150px) never acts beyond the button's own bounds -- the effect only engages once the pointer is already on the button. Return-to-centre rAF re-created on every position state change (returnToCenter depends on position, L214). setState per pointermove. Reduced motion checked via matchMedia call during render (L284-292) -- not reactive and an SSR hydration mismatch risk for the inline transform style.
a11y: Inherits GlassButton semantics; optional announceInteractions announces 'Interactive magnetic button available' to screen readers (L101) -- noise with no value for AT users.
api: forwardRef<HTMLElement>; magneticDampingFactor documented 'not directly used' (L33). Adds another <Motion> wrapper div (L296) around GlassButton's own wrapper div -> two wrapper divs. User style.transform is overwritten.
ssr: 'use client'; uses safe env helpers but matchMedia in render.
fake_complexity: Low-medium: magnetic pull is real but radius semantics are false.
duplicates: OptimizedGlass 'magnet' prop already used by GlassButton (GlassButton.tsx:977)
justification: A thin effect wrapper whose headline parameter (radius) does not work because pull is gated on hover, with an unused damping prop, matchMedia in render and double wrapper divs. GlassButton already passes `magnet` to OptimizedGlass; expose one properly implemented magnetic option there and delete this component.

name: LiquidGlassButtonStyle
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial wrapper (radius='full', interactive) around a transparent <button> (L22-36). Clean use of the shared liquid primitive; material lives on a wrapper element, not the button.
motion: Inherits LiquidGlassMaterial interaction; no own reduced-motion handling needed.
a11y: Native button, but class 'glass-outline-none' (L27; glass.css:3768 outline:none) with no focus-visible replacement on the button, and the visual pill is the wrapper -> keyboard focus is invisible. type='button' default but overridable.
api: forwardRef to the inner button; className applies to button, not the visible pill wrapper (no way to style/position the surface). prominent only toggles text class. Sizes sm..xl vs GlassButton xs..xl.
target: GlassButton (material='liquid' as the default Liquid Glass button)
justification: The cleanest code in the button folder, and closest to the 'Liquid Glass' direction, but it duplicates GlassButton's material='liquid' path, kills the focus outline, and puts className on the wrong element. Its simplicity (one primitive, a native button) is exactly what the redesigned GlassButton should look like; merge it in and delete it. No certification screenshot exists.

name: GlassCalendar
material_impl: GlassCard shell + GlassButton nav. Imports CardHeader/CardTitle/CardContent from '../card' (L15), whose index.ts exports untyped `any` stubs that render plain div/h2 with 'card-header'/'card-title' classes (src/components/card/index.ts) -- NOT the styled GlassCard.tsx subcomponents. Selected/today use 'glass-foundation-complete glass-backdrop-blur bg-transparent border-white/40' + inline var(--glass-neutral-level2-surface) (L19-21, L558). Event colors are Tailwind default 'bg-blue-500/80' etc. (L314-322), and event.color is applied as a class name, so passing a CSS color silently fails.
motion: Reduced motion respected for hover scale and skeleton pulse (L332, L553-555). GlassButton nav inherits its ungated motion.
a11y: Day cells are buttons with full date aria-labels (L565) but no grid semantics (role=grid/gridcell), no aria-selected / aria-current='date', no roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation -> 35-42 tab stops per month. 'focus:outline-none' on day buttons (L554) relies on glass-focus. Weekday headers hard-coded English 'Sun..Sat' regardless of locale (L464), week always starts Sunday. Compact headers hide visible text with aria-hidden and put aria-label on a generic div (L472-482) -- label on non-interactive div is ignored. GlassCalendarEventCard compact variant is a clickable div with no role/keyboard (L735-743).
api: Not forwardRef (React.FC). view='week'|'day' and dateFormat props declared but ignored (only month view). selectedDate semi-controlled (copied into state, L142-147). ...props spread onto GlassCard though interface declares none. 'Reference/Legacy' title suggests it is already deprecated in docs but still root-exported.
ssr: 'use client'; new Date() in initial state -> server/client timezone/day mismatch risk for 'today' highlighting.
fake_complexity: Medium: advertised week/day views do not exist.
target: shared Calendar grid primitive used by GlassDatePicker
justification: A calendar is a credibility component; this one lacks grid semantics and arrow-key navigation, ignores locale for weekdays/week start, advertises unimplemented week/day views, uses Tailwind default palette for events, and is wired to stub Card subcomponents. The certification capture is a small, low-contrast grey grid (saturation 0.2). Redesign as one accessible calendar-grid primitive (role=grid, roving focus, Intl weekday names, firstDayOfWeek) shared with GlassDatePicker; drop the decorative event list or make it a separate composition.

name: div (card/div.tsx)

stories.note: story titled 'Surfaces/Cards + Panels/div' with intent/elevation/tier argTypes that GlassCard ignores

material_impl: `export const div = GlassCard` (L13) plus a third set of CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter with shadcn-style p-6 spacing (L16-74) that conflicts with GlassCard.tsx's own subcomponents and card/index.ts stubs.
api: Exporting a component named lowercase `div` is a footgun (shadows the JSX intrinsic name in user code, confuses tooling).
justification: An accidental artifact (likely a codemod that rewrote <Card> to <div>) that adds a third conflicting set of Card subcomponents and a story/certification target named 'div'. Not root-exported; delete it along with its story/test and the stub exports in card/index.ts.

name: GlassCardLink
material_impl: No glass at all: a plain <a> with radius/overflow/transition classes (L22-30). 'Glass' is in name only.
motion: Motion wrapper with no preset; 'transition-all duration-300'. useReducedMotion called and unused (L19).
a11y: Focus ring via 'focus:ring-primary-500' Tailwind default palette + glass-focus; 'focus:outline-none' (L27). Native anchor semantics OK.
api: Not forwardRef (React.FC); no asChild for Next.js Link/router integration; wrapper div from Motion gets no className.
fake_complexity: Name implies a glass card; it is an unstyled link wrapper.
target: GlassCard with asChild/href (or interactive/GlassCardLink if kept)
justification: Two different components named GlassCardLink exist; the root export points at this one, which renders no glass, has no ref forwarding and no router integration. Replace with GlassCard supporting asChild/href so a link card is a glass card.

name: GlassCard
material_impl: Shared primitives: OptimizedGlassCore (L237) or LiquidGlassMaterial when material='liquid' (L159). Variant -> elevation/depth/border mapping (L121-131, L239-242). But it stacks 7 extra material utilities on the root ('glass-foundation-complete glass-overlay-noise glass-edge glass-overlay-specular ...', L246) on top of OptimizedGlass, plus up to 3 hover overlay divs whose class strings are nonsense repetitions ('glass-gradient-primary glass-gradient-primary glass-via-transparent glass-gradient-primary', L289-306). Hard-coded 'hover:shadow-blue-500/10' (L256) and liquid tints {59,130,246,.08}/{0,0,0,.06} (L182-183). Variants 'outlined' vs 'outline' and 'default' vs 'primary' vs 'elevated' are near-identical.
motion: Reduced motion honoured for scale/translate/pulse (L112-114, L254-266) -- correctly wired. Dynamic Tailwind duration classes (L114, L194, L247, L289-299) won't be generated by JIT. Liquid path has 'glass-hover-scale-105 active:scale-95' -- a 5% scale on a card is heavy-handed.
a11y: Good: actionable cards get role=button, tabIndex 0, Enter/Space handler (L134-149, L270-281), aria-disabled, aria-busy. Disabled uses pointer-events-none (still focusable if tabIndex passed). Loading skeleton replaces children with no sr text.
api: forwardRef, className + rest passthrough. No asChild/as (cannot render as <a>/<article>/<li>). tint prop accepts string|rgba object but only the object form is used (liquid path); string tint is silently ignored in glass path. Subcomponents CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter/CardActions are well-typed and forwardRef'd but are NOT exported from src/index.ts (only GlassCard/Card at L272-273), and card/index.ts re-exports `any` stubs under the same names -> consumers and internal callers (GlassCalendar) get the stubs. CardContent autoSpacing defaults true (surprising). CardTitle level switch is fine.
justification: Solid bones -- shared primitive, real keyboard/role handling, reduced motion actually wired -- making it the best flagship candidate in this shard. It needs polish, not rewrite: delete the redundant utility stack and junk overlay class strings, collapse 8 variants to ~4 (plain/elevated/outlined/interactive), remove blue hover shadow and 5% scale, add asChild, export the typed subcomponents from root and delete the card/index.ts stubs and card/div.tsx copy. Certification capture shows a small, faint card on a white canvas (saturation 0.1) -- the story needs a backdrop that lets glass read.
evidence: src/components/card/GlassCard.tsx:289-306 nonsense repeated gradient class strings
src/index.ts:272-273 only GlassCard/Card exported; no CardHeader etc.

name: GlowingCard
material_impl: Wraps GlassCard inside a bespoke div with a blurred gradient glow layer; neon defaults '#00d4ff', rainbow '#ff006e/#00d4ff/#00ff88' (L44, L88-90, L173-188) -- off-palette cyberpunk colours. Injects a global, unscoped <style> block per instance (L162-249) defining .glowing-card / @keyframes glowPulse globally. The only story overrides glowColor to rgba(255,255,255,0.95) (stories L38) so the certified screenshot shows no glow at all (crop saturation 0, luminance 231-239).
motion: CSS keyframes; reduced motion handled both in JS (glow layer removed, L150) and via @media in the injected style (L241-248). Animates filter: blur on hover (expensive).
a11y: role=button + tabIndex + Enter/Space when onClick (L134-146). Nested GlassCard inside clickable div is fine. cursor:pointer default even without onClick when interactive=true (L120).
api: forwardRef but no rest-prop passthrough (only className/style/data-testid/aria-label), so id, onMouseEnter, aria-* etc. are dropped. className applied to outer wrapper, not the card. Not composable with GlassCard props (variant/size/material).
ssr: 'use client'; <style> injection renders on server too (OK) but duplicates per instance.
duplicates: GlassCard (hoverable glow overlay already present, GlassCard.tsx:285-302)
target: GlassCard glow/emphasis prop (token-driven accent edge light)
justification: Neon/rainbow glow is the 'generic glassmorphism template' look the premium bar rejects, implemented with a global per-instance style injection and dropped props. Its single story even neutralises the glow, so the certified screenshot proves nothing. If an emphasised card is needed, make it a token-driven edge-light/emphasis option on GlassCard.

name: Card patterns (BasicCard, FeatureCard, StatCard, ProfileCard, NotificationCard, PricingCard, ActivityCard)
material_impl: Composes GlassCard + its typed subcomponents (good reuse). Hard-coded Tailwind default status colours 'text-green-500/text-red-500' (L165-166), 'border-l-blue-500' etc. (L314-317), 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2' (L412). Emoji status icons 'ℹ️ ✅ ⚠️ ❌' (L320-325) and unicode trend arrows (L170-174) instead of the library icon set (src/icons).
a11y: NotificationCard dismiss button renders '×' with no aria-label (L365-370). Emoji icons are read aloud. StatCard trend conveyed by colour + arrow glyph only, no sr text. FeatureCard image alt duplicates title. PricingCard list uses 'glass-gap-2' on a ul (no flex -> gap no-op, L439).
api: Plain functions, no forwardRef, no rest props; BasicCardProps declares intent/elevation/tier but never uses them (L31-38). Negative margin 'glass--m-6' assumes p-6 while GlassCard default is p-4 (L97) -> image bleeds incorrectly.
target: docs recipes / dashboard GlassStatCard / marketing ShowcaseCard
justification: Useful as documentation recipes showing GlassCard composition, but as library API they are not root-exported, duplicate dedicated dashboard/marketing cards, and use emoji icons, Tailwind default status colours and an unlabeled dismiss button. Move them to docs examples built on the polished GlassCard and the icon set; do not ship as components.
evidence: src/components/card/patterns.tsx:97 glass--m-6 vs GlassCard p-4 default

name: Non-exported internals (GlassButton.tsx/GlassFab.tsx/EnhancedGlassButton.tsx/GlassCalendar.tsx/card index)
material_impl: IconButton (GlassButton.tsx:1042), ButtonGroup (:1092, cloneElement-based, uses rounded-r-none Tailwind not glass radius), ToggleButton (:1171, name clash with root-exported components/toggle-button/ToggleButton), FloatingActionButton (:1227, duplicate of GlassFab), ConsciousGlassButton/GazeResponsiveButton/PredictiveButton/AccessibleButton (:1280-1364) and ButtonConsciousnessPresets (:1369); Fab (GlassFab.tsx:356, default export); PhysicsGlassButton/ImmersiveGlassButton/VRGlassButton/SmartAdaptiveButton/UltraEnhancedButton (EnhancedGlassButton.tsx:485-592); GlassCalendarEventCard (GlassCalendar.tsx:697); card/index.ts `any` stubs for CardHeader/CardTitle/CardContent/CardFooter; button/index.ts re-exports IconButton and GlassMagneticButton alias.
a11y: IconButton requires aria-label in type (good). AccessibleButton preset is mislabeled: it enables biometric size reduction and audio, not accessibility.
api: IconButton is the only useful internal; it is not root-exported though icon buttons are a core need.
fake_complexity: Conscious/Gaze/Predictive/Accessible presets and Enhanced presets are marketing wrappers over simulated engines.
duplicates: card/index.ts stubs vs GlassCard.tsx subcomponents vs card/div.tsx
target: Keep IconButton (export from root, built on redesigned GlassButton); delete the rest
justification: Dead-weight duplicates and marketing presets that are unreachable from the public entry but still compiled and shipped in dist via the files that define them. IconButton should be promoted and root-exported; everything else should be removed, and card/index.ts must stop exporting `any` stubs that shadow the real typed subcomponents.
